name: Recipe of the Kaldorei
summary: Zarrin teaches a lesson in balance through the Recipe of the Kaldorei. In Dolanaar, young cooks learn to gather only what they need from Teldrassil's woods.

sections.title: Children of the Stars
sections.body: Behind the inn in Dolanaar, Zarrin tends a bubbling cauldron and teaches young adventurers the traditions of his people. The night elves once called themselves the kaldorei, or children of the stars. Zarrin begins their understanding of that heritage with the bond between a hunter, their food, and Teldrassil's boughs, rather than the battlefield.

sections.title: Taking Only What Is Needed
sections.body: Zarrin teaches restraint through a simple demand: gather small spider legs from the woodland arachnids outside Shadowglen, but take exactly seven. The kaldorei seek harmony with nature by taking only what they need and showing kindness to the wild. Even in troubled times, that balance matters. A spider kabob becomes a lesson in living with care.

faq.answer: Zarrin is a night elf who tends a cauldron behind the inn in Dolanaar. He teaches young adventurers to cook while honoring kaldorei traditions.

faq.q: Why does Zarrin insist on collecting exactly seven spider legs?
faq.answer: Zarrin asks for exactly seven spider legs to teach that the kaldorei take only what they need and live in harmony with nature. The lesson encourages respect for the living forest and its balance.
Kaldorei means children of the stars in the Darnassian tongue. It is the ancient name the night elves have used for themselves for thousands of years.

faq.q: Where are the spider legs gathered?
faq.answer: Gather the legs from webwood spiders in Teldrassil's forests, outside Shadowglen's sheltered borders.

faq.q: What do night elves prepare with spider legs?
faq.answer: Zarrin teaches young adventurers to prepare Kaldorei Spider Kabobs, a traditional wilderness dish made from woodland spider meat for a nourishing meal on the road.

faq.q: Do all spiders in Teldrassil yield the legs needed?
faq.answer: No. Immature spiders in Shadowglen do not yield the proper legs for Zarrin's recipe. Gather them from spiders roaming the wider woods of Teldrassil.

angles.text: Learning to cook in Teldrassil brings the recipe for Kaldorei Spider Kabobs.
As a night elf, you learn the kaldorei way of keeping harmony with nature through restraint and taking only what you need.
